text: {"action": null, "answer": "Project Zenith is an initiative aimed at optimizing cloud storage solutions for enhanced security and accessibility, led by Marcus Cole, with a kickoff scheduled for July 15th, 2023. The project has seen significant progress, including the completion of the design phase and the successful testing of a prototype for secure file sharing ahead of schedule. The team is now moving into the development phase, with lead developer Omar Jensen providing guidance. Five new team members specializing in cybersecurity and cloud architecture have joined to accelerate progress. A milestone celebration for the completion of the testing phase is planned for October 10th. The next phase involves user interface enhancements starting in October, and feedback on the prototype's performance and user experience is being sought by the end of November. Security protocols have been updated to include multi-factor authentication and encryption at rest, effective from January next year. Additionally, the project is exploring partnership opportunities with TechInnovate to leverage their AI technology. The budget for the compliance plan has been increased to $55,000 to include additional training and third-party audits."}
